name: Tsurumi Himari
source:
Himari is the Student Council President of Kimisaki Academy. She's memorized the names and faces of every single student in the school, and plans all sorts of events with the vision that they can have a fun school life. Although she's not very book-smart, the Student Council members have strong faith in her. She has a penchant for giving people nicknames.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
